title: Improve Codex Desktop UX + workspace workflow
description: Goals: make Codex Desktop actually run Codex (not stub), improve onboarding (API key + config), add workspace folder selection, surface model override + sandbox mode for performance/safety, improve streaming/progress UX, and harden packaged builds. Audit: main builds CJS so ESM @openai/codex-sdk import fails -> stub; no settings UI for API key/config; dev .env path mismatch vs README; pickCwd IPC unused; runTask uses non-existent runStream; packaged asar likely blocks executing codex binary without unpack/path override.
notes:
Implemented Settings (API key, workspace folder, output folder, model override, sandbox mode, include file contents), added toolbar + improved Save As UX, wired real Codex execution via ESM-safe dynamic import + runStreamed streaming, and now embeds dropped file contents into the effective prompt when enabled. Hardened packaging (asarUnpack for codex binary), added interface contract Makefile + .agents.yml, and un-ignored/tracked codex-desktop/config/.env.example for onboarding.

Tests: AGENT_MODE=baseline make setup; AGENT_MODE=baseline make all (Playwright: 4 passed).
close_reason: Implemented + validated; see notes for commands.

title: Onboarding: prompt for API key + app-managed Codex config
description: Follow-up: on fresh install, app should proactively ask for API key, create/manage Codex config internally (no manual copying), and default to latest GPT-5.2 model (verify online). Also run packaging builds, clean temp files, and update GitHub via PR.
